public_release.release_reason: Operational notice from enrolled public repo to DAD hub; no private source content included.

payload.summary: DAD preflight unavailable in Codex shell because asset-dir is not on PATH.
observed_commands: asset-dir agent preflight --repo . --agent codex --task "Re-run Codex integrator review on PR #131 SUB-007/SUB-008 fixes"
payload.observed_error: asset-dir: The term 'asset-dir' is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet, function, script file, or operable program.
payload.impact: Agents cannot run required DAD preflight or immediate mail digest from this shell; repo validators continue, but DAD preflight is recorded as environment noise.
payload.requested_action: DAD should provide an install/PATH repair instruction or documented fallback for enrolled repos when asset-dir is unavailable.

evidence: AGENTS.md requires asset-dir agent preflight before material AI-assisted work.
.digital-asset/mail/README.md says outbox.jsonl is the local channel for suggestions/notices.
Command failed in local PowerShell during PR #131 Codex integrator review.
suggested_actions: Publish a PATH/setup check for asset-dir in enrolled repo preflight instructions.
Add a fallback no-CLI mail notice workflow for enrolled repos.
Consider adding a lightweight validator that detects DAD CLI availability without blocking repo-local validators.

public_release.release_reason: Operational workflow suggestion to DAD hub; no private source content included.

payload.summary: Enrolled repos need a standard way for coding agents to report DAD tool or workflow errors back to DAD.
payload.reported_bug: asset-dir unavailable on PATH in Codex PowerShell shell during required DAD preflight.
payload.learning_question: Why did an enrolled repo instruct agents to run asset-dir preflight when the command was not available in the agent shell, and what setup/fallback lesson should DAD publish?
payload.future_exception_lake_request: Create or route this class of failures into a DAD exception lake so future repos can correlate DAD CLI/PATH/setup failures, preflight bypasses, mail delivery fallbacks, and recovered workflow lessons.
payload.requested_contract: When any repo coding agent encounters a DAD-specific command, mailbox, enrollment, release, or governance-map error, it should send a categorized DAD outbox notice with command, error, impact, local fallback, sensitivity/public-release status, and suggested DAD lesson.

evidence: logos-scripture-graph AGENTS.md requires asset-dir agent preflight.
asset-dir command was not available on PATH during PR #131 review.
DAD mailbox README already defines outbox.jsonl as the candidate-only channel for suggestions/notices.
suggested_actions: Add a DAD error-reporting message template for enrolled repos.
Define categories such as dad_cli_missing, dad_mail_digest_failed, dad_release_gate_blocked, dad_governance_map_drift, and dad_enrollment_contract_conflict.
Document whether these reports should be governance_notice, workflow_suggestion, lesson_suggestion, or bug_report if DAD adds that message type.
Feed accepted reports into the future DAD exception lake and publish reusable lessons back through DAD mail.
